title: Crop Protection  Pest And Disease Control
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that kill whole trees in orchards or plantations, and those that destroy the actual harvested product, such as fruit or grain."
Easier diseases to assess are those that kill whole trees in orchards or plantations, and those that destroy the actual harvested product, such as fruit or grain.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a strategy to manage pests on the basis of a systems approach that looks at the whole farming ecosystem."
Integrated Pest Management is a strategy to manage pests on the basis of a systems approach that looks at the whole farming ecosystem.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the proportion of plant area that is affected."
Disease severity is the proportion of plant area that is affected.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important step as misidentification is a common cause of control failure."
Accurate identification is the most important step as misidentification is a common cause of control failure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term that describes both products and processes while seed dressing is the process."
Seed treatment is a term that describes both products and processes while seed dressing is the process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first step in any pest management situation."
Pest identification is the first step in any pest management situation.
fib: ______ is the proportion or amount of diseased plants or parts in a population.
Disease incidence is the proportion or amount of diseased plants or parts in a population.
______ is any abnormal condition that damages a plant and reduces its productivity or usefulness to man.
Plant Disease is any abnormal condition that damages a plant and reduces its productivity or usefulness to man.
______ is a technique by which additives such as pesticides, nutrients or nitrifying bacteria can be applied to the seed's external surface (i.e. the testa).
Seed coating or film coating is a technique by which additives such as pesticides, nutrients or nitrifying bacteria can be applied to the seed's external surface (i.e. the testa).
______ is one of the most 21 important aspects of operating an agricultural enterprise especially food processing facility.
Sanitation is one of the most 21 important aspects of operating an agricultural enterprise especially food processing facility.
______ is the most common method of seed treatment.
Seed dressing is the most common method of seed treatment.
